name: Cart Rescue – Abandoned Cart Recovery for WooCommerce
author: Tech Zap

sections.description:
Cart Rescue – Abandoned Cart Recovery for WooCommerce helps you recover lost sales by automatically capturing abandoned carts and sending targeted recovery emails.

Key Features:

  • Real-time cart capture
  • Smart cart status management (in-progress, abandoned, recovered)
  • Customizable email templates with placeholders
  • Automated email sending via cron
  • One-click cart recovery links
  • Comprehensive dashboard with analytics
  • Performance optimized with caching
  • Security-first approach
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatible

Email Placeholders:

  • {{customer_name}} – Full customer name
  • {{first_name}} – Customer’s first name
  • {{last_name}} – Customer’s last name
  • {{cart_items_table}} – HTML table of cart items
  • {{cart_total}} – Formatted cart total
  • {{recovery_link}} – One-click recovery URL
  • {{site_title}} – Website title
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/cart-rescue-abandoned-cart-recovery
  2. Activate the plugin through WordPress admin
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Configure settings in WooCommerce -> Abandoned Carts
  5. Create email templates as needed
sections.faq:
Does this work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, the plugin works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

How does cart capture work?

JavaScript monitors checkout forms and saves cart data when customers enter their email.

Can I customize email templates?

Yes, create custom HTML email templates with dynamic placeholders.

Is it GDPR compliant?

The plugin only captures voluntarily entered checkout information. Add appropriate privacy notices.
